div.div: 3 غَايَا القَوْمُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِ فُلَانٍ بِالسَّيْفِ [The people, or party, acted with the sword above the head of such a one] as though they shadowed him with it; [i. e., flourished it above his head;] from As; (S, K; *) inf. n. مُغَايَاةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
